none: PAS FindID 996633: Lin-26DC42: Roman nummus of Constantine

A Roman copper-alloy nummus of the house of Constantine, AD 335 - AD 337 (Reece period 17). Gloria Exercitus reverse. The coin is worn with the focus of damage present around the exterior edges and reverse surface. Obverse: Clean-shaven, a youthful male, facing right, with a laureate crown with tails behind the head. Inscription: 'CONSTANTI...' (only the beginning of the inscription is legible. It is resemblant of Constantine type, AD 335-337, number 99 (Reece & James, 1986, p.35). Reverse: Portrait of two soldiers holding a single standard. Inscription: not legible. The portrait is the same as Constantine type coins, AD 335 - AD 337, number 98 (Reece & James, 1986, p.35). Mint Mark: Not…
